SUMMARY: The CreateTraces receiver factory function signature must be updated to include a new logger parameter. All receiver factories need to update their signatures accordingly. This change ensures that receivers have access to a logger instance for logging purposes.

FILES:
- otelcol/receivers/factory.go — Update CreateTraces signature to include logger parameter
- otelcol/receivers/otlp/factory.go — Update CreateTraces signature to include logger parameter
- otelcol/receivers/jaeger/factory.go — Update CreateTraces signature to include logger parameter
- otelcol/receivers/zipkin/factory.go — Update CreateTraces signature to include logger parameter
- otelcol/receivers/prometheus/factory.go — Update CreateTraces signature to include logger parameter
